purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - inpatient (入院) actual-days count editing component
purpose.summary: ORCR0630 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt software suite. It processes inpatient hospitalization receipt data, editing and calculating actual hospitalization days, fee calculations, and related medical insurance billing data. It reads and writes indexed RECE62 files and an error file, performing complex fee computation logic for Japanese national health insurance claims.

notable_features: Large working-storage with multi-dimensional OCCURS tables
Indexed file I/O with DYNAMIC access mode
399 PERFORM statements indicating highly structured procedural logic
Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
No COMP-3 usage despite numeric-heavy domain
Realtime preview processing noted in change log
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in Japanese (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but decoded as latin-1, resulting in mojibake. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system.
